title: GeoNode CSW metadata XML integrity
status: focused CSW serializer integrity checks pass; capability not accepted
changes: ISO 19115 metadata values are escaped as XML text before serialization, preventing caller-supplied values from breaking document structure or injecting elements; characters forbidden by XML 1.0 are replaced with U+FFFD.
CSW record responses declare the gmd and gco namespaces used by their child elements.
The Leaflet map builds farm popups with DOM text nodes rather than interpolating database metadata into HTML.
Map coordinates are parsed as finite WGS84 values with legal latitude/longitude ranges; zero-valued coordinates are retained.
GIS boundary parsing validates finite WGS84 positions, ring closure, and a bounded coordinate count before WKT generation; Polygon and MultiPolygon builders preserve every interior ring.
GIS import validates target, file format, and source records before opening PostgreSQL; empty or malformed source inputs do not acquire a database connection.
GIS import supports KML Placemark Polygon and MultiGeometry polygon boundaries, preserves interior rings and ExtendedData fields, and parses with defusedxml to reject entity declarations.
Focused tests parse both serializer outputs, verify markup-shaped input remains text, protect the map popup/coordinate contract, and exercise GeoJSON/CSV/KML validation and serialization.

verification.result: 36 passed, including CSW serializer, map viewer, GeoJSON/CSV/KML, and import-redaction checks
verification.ruff: python3 -m ruff check on changed CSW, GIS import, and focused test files: passed
verification.compilation: python3 -m compileall -q on changed CSW, GIS import, and focused test files: passed
verification.javascript: Extracted Leaflet inline script passes node --check.
verification.database_or_provider: None used; preflight tests assert PostgreSQL is not opened for invalid or empty source inputs.

scope_limits: This work does not add a CSW HTTP endpoint, catalog query implementation, or establish ISO 19115 semantic/output parity against a GeoNode reference fixture.

The map still fetches the legacy Directus path; a tenant-scoped Gateway map API and layer authorization are not implemented. KML styling, altitude preservation, raster GroundOverlay ingestion, PostGIS apply/recovery, and populated spatial fixture parity were not exercised. Geostory runtime access, thesaurus integration, and MAN-CAP-063 owner acceptance remain open.
